market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $120 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month near $104 on May 1, recently spiked above $110 on Iran tensions then pulled back. Hitting $120 (any 1-min high) requires another ~15% move in 31 days. Plausible if Middle East situation escalates further but base-rate for that magnitude monthly move is modest.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Pace and severity of Iran/Strait of Hormuz developments and OPEC+ response.
